verdict.rationale: Launching agent tasks from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack is a fair question for a coding agent, but the evidence shows no such integration in Aider. Aider is started from a local CLI, an IDE watch mode, or a browser UI. Its `--message` scripting and Python `Coder` API are only building blocks a developer could use to wire up such triggers, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack
